hooks.command: sh -c 'W="${CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR}/.trivium/bin/trivium"; test -x "$W" || exit 0; exec "$W" gate hook-pre-write'
sh -c 'W="${CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR}/.trivium/bin/trivium"; test -x "$W" || exit 0; exec "$W" gate hook-pre-commit'
sh -c 'W="${CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR}/.trivium/bin/trivium"; test -x "$W" || exit 0; exec "$W" gate hook-stop'
sh -c 'W="${CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR}/.trivium/bin/trivium"; test -x "$W" || exit 0; exec "$W" gate hook-session-start'
